title: bus wait (expected result)
description: Bus v2.6. One file $AB_HOME/waits/<agent>/@<slug>/<task_id>.json per delegated task whose result a session waits for, written atomically (tmp + rename). Created by whoever delegates (agent-bus-mcp bus_send expect_result / bus_expect, lib ab_expect); moved on ONLY by scripts/agent-team-os-wake.py (expected -> woken | seen | blocked | expired). A task_id has a single wait bus-wide. Dot-files in the same folder (.wakes.log, .woken.json) belong to the wake script. Readers ignore unknown fields.

task_id.description: Canonical t-<YYYYMMDD>-<rand6>. Also the file name.

host.description: Machine of the waiting session; only that machine's wake script touches the file.

description.description: A few words, shown in the wake prompt and in the bus-band.

delegated_to.description: Address of whoever does the work.

deadline.description: Past it with no result: state expired and one notice in the waiter's inbox (no wake).

state.description: expected = waiting. woken = result arrived, prompt written once. seen = the session read the result itself before any wake. blocked = the result came from a session just woken (wake_chain): no chain. expired = deadline passed with no result. cancelled = withdrawn by hand.

target.description: How to reach the waiting session's prompt, captured from its environment at registration.

pending_wake.description: The result is in the inbox but the wake is postponed: reason (onda:working, onda:has_text, tmux:busy, tetto_orario, onda_senza_guardia, nessun_canale, ...), since, checked_at.

woken_via.description: onda | tmux, with :non_confermato when the submit was not seen on screen.
